name: Sudipta Nath
title: AI Engineer
summary: AI Engineer building LLM, RAG and multimodal systems, with experience in document forensics, multilingual dialogue and full-stack delivery. Master of IT (Artificial Intelligence), Macquarie University, completed July 2026.

bullets: Built a Python document-forensics pipeline combining ELA heatmaps, PDF structural analysis and Qwen3-VL-235B via AWS Bedrock Converse, with a RAG component.

Automated false-positive/negative regression benchmarking across 12 versions. Final evaluation: 40/40 modified documents detected, zero false positives (bounded evaluation set; genuine-control count not supplied).
Diagnosed fine-grained signal loss from vision-encoder patch averaging; changed inputs and decision logic. Wrote R&D handover documentation.
